approvalNote: A approved as filed; 'A:[4]' is an approved value with a remark flag, kept as filed
checksumNote: sum over rows of Math.round(depthToWaterFt*100); every filed value carries at most 2 decimals, so the product is float-exact
distanceNote: haversine from Cushing town center (35.9842,-96.7670) to well (36.06092778,-96.750675); nearest Payne County GW well carrying a waterservices DV series; no Cushing-named well exists (station names are PLSS; CUSHING appears only as topo quad name)
label: Cushing/Payne USGS groundwater, daily confounder, not busy
maxDepthNote: larger value means deeper water table (depth below land surface)
missingRule: NWIS publishes one row per day; a missing day would be an absent row, never a 0 — the span is gapless, so nothing was filled
notStreamflow: this file carries parameter 72019 depth-to-water in feet, never 00060 discharge in cfs; site 07161450 is not used here
parameter: 72019 depth to water level below land surface in feet, daily mean (statCd 00003)
source: USGS Waterservices NWIS DV, keyless HTTPS
unit: depth_to_water_ft = feet below land surface datum, as filed
